title: A geothermal day in Rotorua
dek: How to sequence parks and lake time without overcommitting the clock.

hero.alt: Geothermal steam drifting through trees on mineral ground

body: Begin with a geothermal park that publishes accessibility notes, then return to the lakefront when steam and sulphur feel like enough for the morning.
Keep evening cultural experiences optional until ticketing integrations are live — this guide stays editorial.
